rationale.candidateRecall: At least 85% of source-supported identities must enter the 50-candidate pool; retrieval must not conceal ranker misses.
rationale.top1: 40% is a provisional development floor for an expanded 384-record draft pack; not a publication criterion.
rationale.top3: 60% requires a majority of descriptions to surface the target near the top.
rationale.top10: 80% requires useful recall within the UI limit; no lower floor chosen after observing output.
rationale.safety: All explicit no-match, regional conflict and confidence-limit contracts must hold. Per-case rank requirements are also enforced.
rationale.publication: Zero eligible identities means quality is not evaluated; never report 0/0 as success. Positive targets absent from the subset are coverage-blocked, not no-match successes.

rankPolicy: Diagnostic combinations: top3; paraphrases and intentionally ambiguous alternatives: top10. No expected identity is derived from engine output.
confidencePolicy: Scores are relativeMatch, not calibrated probabilities. Ambiguous probes <=0.64; others finite in [0,1].
independence: Development-only synthetic source-informed data, some based on catalogue transcriptions. Not an independent human holdout; existing frozen cohort remains untouched.
erratum: v1 generated its ID lookup by common name across both packs. The Pacific Spotted Eagle Ray overwrote the intended Caribbean record. v2 corrects only s08 identity/reference and the two ray cases selected pack/expected ID according to the already cited western Atlantic source. Descriptions, bounds and thresholds unchanged. v1 artifacts retained; v2 is not an independent unseen evaluation.
